header.title: Puzzles
header.sub: Quiet mental exercises — play one, or come back later.

toast.niceWork: Nice work taking a moment for yourself.

note: These puzzles are here for a calm pause. They are not treatment — take your time, and there is nothing to prove.

block.title: Block puzzle
block.body: Drop simple shapes onto a 9x9 board and clear full rows and columns.

sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.body: A gentle 9x9 puzzle with a fresh grid each time and a check button.

wordsearch.title: Word search
wordsearch.body: Find eight calm, study-themed words hidden in a 12x12 grid.

jigsaw.title: Jigsaw
jigsaw.body: Swap the tiles of a soothing picture until it all comes together.

riddles.title: Riddles
riddles.body: Five little riddles to turn over, with hints whenever you like.

memory.title: Memory puzzles
memory.body: Match the calming pairs on a 4x4 board at your own pace.

chessCard.title: Chess
chessCard.subtitle: A friendly game of chess — take your time, there is no clock.

block.hint: Click a piece, then a valid cell to place. Complete rows/columns to clear.

sudoku.hint: Click cell, then number. Check compares against solution.

wordSearch.hint: Click the first letter, then the last letter of a word along a straight line.

jigsaw.hint: Click two tiles to swap. Arrange to form the picture.

0.question: What gets wetter as it dries?

1.question: What has to be broken before you can use it?

2.question: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?

3.question: What can fill a room but takes no space?

4.question: What goes up but never comes down?

riddleGame.hint: Think gently about the common answer.

memory.won: You matched all pairs in {{moves}} moves.
